spans.s:
mfn. (-क्ता-क्त्री-क्त)
Breaking, a breaker, who or what breaks.
E.
भञ्ज to break, तृप् aff.

m. (-ङ्गः)
1 Breaking, splitting.
2 A chasm, a fissure, a division.
3 Defeat, discomfiture.
4 Disappointment.
5

Dishonesty, fraud, circumvention, cheating.
7 Going, motion.
8 A wave.
9 A water-course, a canal.
10 Disease in general.
11 A disease, (hemiplegia, palsy.)
12 Interruption of the voice.
f. (-ङ्गा)
1 Hemp, (Cannabis sativa.)
2 A plant, commonly

A fibrous plant from which a sort of flax is obtained, (Crotolaria juncea.)
E.
भञ्ज to break, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-भाक्)
Breaking, being broken.
E.
भङ्ग, and भाज् partaking.

mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं)
Crafty, fraudulent, dishonest.
E.
भङ्ग breaking, fraud, &c. स for सम् with, and अर्थ object.

m. (-नः)
A sort of fish, (Cyprinus Banggana, HAM.)
E.
भङ्ग a wave, अन to live, aff. अच्.

f. (-ङ्गिः-ङ्गी)
1 Fracture, division, separation.
2 Fraud, deception, trick, disguise.
3

Wit, repartee.
5 A wave.
E.
भञ्ज to break, aff. इन् and ङीप् optionally added.

n. (-लं)
Defect in the organs of sense.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
1 Crooked, bent.
2 Fraudulent, crafty, dishonest.
m. (-रः)
The bend or elbow of a river.
E.
भञ्ज to break, aff. घुरच्.

n. (-ङ्ग्यं)
A field of hemp.
E.
भङ्गा hemp, यत् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Bearing hemp, (a field, &c.)
E.
भङ्ग hemp, and खञ् aff.
